name: todaynyc
description: Mary helps prepare curated three-hour Manhattan plans, the available NYC weekend edition, and estimated airport journeys using curated data and traveler-supplied times.

interface.longDescription: Mary helps you prepare your arrival, three hours in Manhattan, the available NYC weekend edition and your return. Estimate one flight using the airports, timezones and local ticket times you provide, then curated EWR/JFK/LGA–Penn transfers by car, rail or bus with clearly labelled connections. Any access from another starting place uses your chosen airport and time estimate. LGA rail includes a bus connection; JFK/LGA bus options also include rail or metro. Updates use facts you report, without flight tracking, live traffic or third-party data APIs. Transfer ranges are editorial estimates with curated official route sources, not operator guarantees. Critical warnings and a short summary appear first, with optional details. Travel state is temporary and can be forgotten; no bookings, payments, nearest-airport search or live availability. Manhattan plans retain their exact 180-minute and freshness limits. Weekend briefings state their actual edition dates.
capabilities: Generate curated three-hour Manhattan plan options
Resolve a neighborhood, station or known New York place
Read the current curated NYC weekend edition
Summarize weekend weather, city notices and mobility impacts
Expose canonical plan identifiers and published source links
Add attributed historical, architectural and cultural route context
Show interactive route and weekend-highlight maps inline in the conversation
Explain TodayNYC's no-booking, no-ticketing and no-live-availability limits
Estimate outbound and return journeys using curated time ranges
Recalculate traveler-confirmed travel stages without external APIs
defaultPrompt: Hola Mary, ¿qué puedes hacer por mí?
Quiero preparar mi llegada a Nueva York y mi regreso.
Quiero un plan de tres horas en Manhattan.
